title: Cold-start restore harness, KV-consistency audit, and staged circuit-breaker experiments
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Build an automated harness that validates full cold-start backup restores and verifies KV-cache and tokenstore consistency across active-passive region switchovers. The harness will run reproducible scenarios (snapshot restore, index rebuild, warmup traffic, and synthetic workloads) and produce a measurable pass/fail signal for our DR readiness scorecard.

Scope:
- Orchestrate snapshot restore into an isolated test VPC (cold-start) and validate functional correctness of requests served from restored storage.
- Run deterministic KV-cache consistency checks against live and restored instances (prefix checks, checkpoint reconciliation, and probabilistic sampling for large stores).
- Execute staged circuit-breaker experiments that simulate resource pressure and measure graceful degradation and load-shedding behavior.
- Measure and record RTO/RPO, token error rates, p50/p95/p99 latencies, and per-route failure modes.

Success criteria:
- Automated harness completes the restore and validates end-to-end request correctness for 95% of canary prompt sets within 3 hours (RTO target).
- KV-consistency audit shows zero missing keys for high-priority prefixes and <0.01% divergence for sampled keys.
- Circuit-breaker experiments demonstrate predictable load-shedding with documented fallback rates and do not exceed a 1% customer-visible error spike on synthetic traffic.

Out-of-scope: full-scale cross-region live switch of production traffic (will be scheduled as a separate staged exercise once harness is green).
runbook_checklist: Provision test VPC and isolated cluster from snapshot catalog
Restore tokenstore and index snapshots to candidate cluster
Boot model-serving runtime in cold-start mode with tracing enabled
Run KV prefix reconciliation job and collect reports
Warmup with deterministic prompt set (1000 short prompts + 200 long-context prompts)
Inject circuit-breaker pressure scenarios: memory surge, GPU throttling, DB latency
Observe fallback routing and load-shedding metrics, then run rollback if failed
Produce report and upload artifacts to DR dashboard
test_scenarios: Scenario A: Cold restore of primary tokenstore + warmup; validate prompt correctness and latency profile
Scenario B: Cold restore then run prefix-scan KV audit against golden manifest (sampling for large tables)
Scenario C: Induce high DB latency to trigger circuit-breaker and validate graceful degradation (assert fallback path serves <= 5% increased latency)
Scenario D: Simultaneous restore + high-throughput synthetic traffic to validate load-shedding thresholds and autoscaler behavior
comments: 2026-02-19 - Aisha Patel: Initial draft of harness design. Covered key failure modes and metrics. Linked snapshot catalog and DR dashboard template.

2026-02-24 - Liam O'Connor: Spun up POC cluster and verified restore automation can complete end-to-end on a small snapshot (link to PR below). Need tighter sampling for KV audits to reduce false positives.

2026-03-02 - Priya Raman (SRE review): Recommend adding canary failure injection step that exercises our fallback routing policy before declaring pass. Also requested separate retention for test logs for 90 days.

2026-03-05 - Security (Eve Martinez): Confirmed no customer secrets are used in test snapshots. Recommend KMS audit logging on temporary keys. Marked security_review_required=false but requested KMS integration ticket if we flip to production snapshots.
2026-03-10 - Liam O'Connor: Implemented KV-checker sampling and added probabilistic reconciliation. End-to-end POC passed against the toy snapshot. Draft PR created.
decision_log: Decision 2026-02-21: Use isolated test VPCs with ephemeral IAM roles for restores to avoid any risk to prod. Trade-off: longer provision time vs safety; chosen safety.

Decision 2026-02-25: Prefer probabilistic KV sampling for large namespaces to keep run duration under 90 minutes. Trade-off: small chance of undetected divergence; mitigation: escalate full scan for any anomalous sample result.

Decision 2026-03-03: Run circuit-breaker experiments at 25/50/75% pressure levels to characterize non-linear failure modes rather than a single blast radius. Chosen to better tune thresholds for load-shedding steps.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Test restores could consume significant cluster quota and interfere with Dedicated capacity. Mitigation: enforce low-priority instance types and quota caps; schedule during off-peak windows.
Risk: Sampling misses a rare corruption. Mitigation: auto-trigger full scan and blameless postmortem on any sample failure and include snapshot immutability checks.
Risk: Circuit-breaker experiments could cascade to shared infra (control plane). Mitigation: strictly isolate control plane and use traffic shaping; abort on any control plane anomaly.
